scope: Independent read-only review and synthetic-fixture tests of external audit tooling only; not candidate timing acceptance

closed_findings.finding: verify_pass could omit immutable CDC review mapping or misstate recomputed physical values
closed_findings.resolution: Exact review file-set/hash equality plus comparison of every recomputed physical result field; negative cases in test_pass_numbers_and_deleted_review_map_rejected

closed_findings.finding: Generated original XCI files were not in the immutable re-audit input snapshot
closed_findings.resolution: All original board XCI path/SHA set captured and checked in assert_unchanged; test_generated_ip_content_and_set_are_bound

closed_findings.finding: Wrapper stdout and native Vivado logging both targeted vivado.log
closed_findings.resolution: Explicit -log vivado-native.log and -journal vivado.jou, separate wrapper vivado.log; both re-audit and export bind all logs

closed_findings.finding: Context test relied on staging-specific parent directories and read its original assertion baseline from another current checkout path
closed_findings.resolution: Helpers resolved only beside the test; baseline fixed to 28 canonical inspect assertions from exact eeb Git blob, source SHA 967b4f7595298cd8c3f83e9540f127c084116de4769939a2bf7bfd6c8155f6e6 and AST SHA e620a076190f7f14ccdb9c609a354c1091c6a74279cce956e41427322ab98469; 14 tests passed both in staging and copied arbitrary repository layout with cwd /tmp.

closed_findings.finding: Final independent review hashes became stale while delivery was still being edited
closed_findings.resolution: Preserved v1; design explicitly froze all delivery bytes; independently rehashed every final proof file and test log, reviewed changed entry/test behavior, and reran 30 entry tests after final freeze.

read_only_tcl_review: No synthesis/optimization/placement/routing, timing exception/clock edits, or write_checkpoint in reaudit.tcl; opens original DCP and emits reports under new obj. Original frozen reset timing and strict timing scripts are used.
remaining: No outstanding tooling review findings. This is not physical acceptance or board validation: route completion, unchanged-DCP new report generation, every new CDC finding review, and actual constrained-STA acceptance remain separate requirements.
archive_review: Original failure and exact original driver/IP/environment/report bytes remain under build/implementation identities. Revised auditor, execution reports and accepted CDC review have separate identities. The revised pass never writes original physical.passed.json. Bitstream export calls only the original frozen export Tcl with the same DCP after recomputed acceptance; archive keeps a local-artifact SHA/size reference rather than claiming the bitstream bytes are packaged.
source_change_boundary: Only explicit auditor/test paths, three final document paths, and the one final evidence subtree may differ. Every production source remains subject to original source-lock/submodule checks; docs/evidence symlinks are rejected. run.sh adds four explicit re-audit/export phases plus an independently gated physical acceptance phase and help.
final_delta_review: run.sh adds the requested physical phase: a separate original gate runs first, so a stale driver fails before physical() can replace any original failure marker. A subprocess fixture verifies exit 7 and byte-identical original failure.
reaudit.py report_files(complete=False) can inventory partial reports after failed Vivado while successful runs still require all report directories. Failure does not create acceptance.
Native Vivado identity verification is now negatively tested even when altered native logs have recomputed hashes.

Original archive, revised archive, extractor, physical_audit.py, reset helper, CDC baseline and reaudit.tcl bytes are unchanged from independent v1 review. Their passed tests were not needlessly repeated; updated archive-selftest output and frozen delivery proof were rehashed.
Portable context test canonical baseline was recomputed independently from the frozen eeb Git blob, never from the current auditor.
